title: Claims Reference Table: Deferred Fixed Annuities Death Benefit and Beneficiary Limits
content:
Claims reference figures for Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities. The figures are identical on every tier — the Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity and the Ashgrove SecureRate 3, 5, 6, 7 and 10 — and are shown once per tier below.

| Tier | Surviving spouse who is sole primary beneficiary may continue the contract as owner | Beneficiary income annuity must begin within (calendar months from the owner's date of death) | Whole death benefit distributed to a beneficiary who does not annuitize within (years from the owner's date of death) | Death claim interest rate (annual, simple) | Most primary beneficiaries | Smallest beneficiary share | Age below which a share is paid only to a guardian or UTMA custodian |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity | Yes | 12 | 5 | 3.5% (0.035) | 10 | 1% | 18 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 3 | Yes | 12 | 5 | 3.5% (0.035) | 10 | 1% | 18 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 5 | Yes | 12 | 5 | 3.5% (0.035) | 10 | 1% | 18 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 6 | Yes | 12 | 5 | 3.5% (0.035) | 10 | 1% | 18 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | Yes | 12 | 5 | 3.5% (0.035) | 10 | 1% | 18 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 10 | Yes | 12 | 5 | 3.5% (0.035) | 10 | 1% | 18 |

**Reference notes.**

- The death claim interest rate is the product's simple annual rate for death claim interest.
- Beneficiary shares are whole percents; 1% is the smallest share a designation may give.
- *Example (hypothetical):* a beneficiary aged 17 is below the age of 18 in the table; a beneficiary aged 18 is not.
